summary: Ship the kit's seven skills, five agents, checkpoint gate beside the chain, root standing files, restyled viewer, and orchestrator as the feature path — without replacing the chain or rewriting existing DECISIONS/CHANGELOG.
plain_summary: After install and init, any machine or repo can run the same step-by-step feature build with two human stops.
gating: Work checkpoints in order. Within a checkpoint, the gates run in order: behavior, then ui, then review. A checkpoint is "passed" only when every gate is "passed" or "n/a". Do not start checkpoint N+1 until checkpoint N has passed.
